# RBI Regulatory Archive 1991-2026 - llms.txt

Agent entry point. Every RBI regulatory PDF, 1991-2026, converted to GitHub-Flavored Markdown. PDFs are the source of truth and live on Hugging Face; this repository holds the Markdown and indexes.

Total PDFs: 88236. Converted: 16500 (18.6999%).
Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/imsovikde/rbi-regulatory-archive-1991-2026

## Indexes

- Master index: INDEX.md
- URL lookup (any RBI or Hugging Face URL to .md path): index/url_to_path_map.json
- Full catalog (one JSON object per document): manifest/master_catalog.jsonl

## Categories

- Master-Directions: 397/397 converted, index/by_category/Master-Directions.md
- Notifications: 2854/10527 converted, index/by_category/Notifications.md
- Master-Circulars: 1013/1013 converted, index/by_category/Master-Circulars.md
- Draft-Notifications-Guidelines: 546/546 converted, index/by_category/Draft-Notifications-Guidelines.md
- Circulars: 11690/11690 converted, index/by_category/Circulars.md
- Press-Releases: 0/64063 converted, index/by_category/Press-Releases.md

## Years

Per-year indexes: index/by_year/<YYYY>.md and index/by_year/<YYYY>.json for 1991 through 2026.

## How to find a document

1. If you have an RBI URL, look it up in index/url_to_path_map.json to get the data/<path>.md file.
2. If you have a category and year, open the matching index/by_year/<YYYY>.md table.
3. Converted Markdown lives under data/<Folder>/<Year>/ with the exact PDF stem and a .md extension.
